sections.A: Frozen shoulder mein kandha dard wala aur akda hua ho jata hai, aur passive range (jab therapist hilaye) bhi saaf kam hoti hai. Yeh diabetes mein zyada hota hai.
sections.B: Dheere dheere dard, aksar raat ko shadeed, aur barhta akdan: baal banane, haath peeche le jaane aur kapre pehnne mein mushkil.
sections.C: Kab shuru hua, akdan kitni tezi se barha, raat ka dard kitna hai, aur kya diabetes ya thyroid hai.
sections.D: Active aur passive range, khaas kar external rotation, aur scapula ki movement.
sections.E: Sab se ahem sign passive external rotation ka bara nuqsan hai: baazu side mein rakh kar bahar ki taraf ghumana.
sections.F: Rotator cuff ke dard mein passive range theek hoti hai; arthritis mein umar zyada aur grinding hoti hai.
sections.G: Daura (seizure), current ka jhatka ya bari chot ke baad akda kandha jis ka rotation bohat kam ho: jor ghalat jagah atka ho sakta hai, foran refer.
sections.H: Red flags aur chot ke baad atka jor rule out karein. Phir passive external rotation ka bara nuqsan aur X-ray normal: frozen shoulder.
sections.I: Dard wale phase mein halki mobilisation bina zor ke; baad mein range ke aakhir tak dheere dheere mobilisation.
sections.J: Pendulum, stick se external rotation, table slide aur symptoms ke mutabiq range ki exercises.
sections.K: Exercise se pehle garmi optional. Ultrasound, laser aur shockwave recommend nahi.
sections.L: Diagnosis aur phase confirm karein, aur samjhayein ke yeh waqt ke saath behtar hota hai. Dard wale phase mein dard control, akde phase mein range barhana.
sections.M: Dard, raat ka dard, passive external rotation, abduction, haath peeche le jaana aur SPADI dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 55 saal ki diabetic khatoon ka kandha raat ko dukhta hai aur haath peeche nahi jata. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, dard control aur symptoms ke mutabiq movement.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
